data.title: Indo-Pakistani War of 1971
data.summary: The December 1971 war between India and Pakistan that ended with the surrender of Pakistani forces in the eastern theatre and the emergence of Bangladesh.
data.content: The bounded candidate record covers the 3–16 December 1971 interstate war and its eastern and western theatres. It deliberately omits casualty totals and political claims that require a wider, separately sourced treatment.

data.title: Operation Trident (1971)
data.summary: The Indian Navy missile-boat attack on Karachi during the 1971 war.
data.content: This candidate is limited to the 4 December 1971 naval attack on Karachi and does not assert a complete order of battle or damage assessment.

data.title: Battle of Longewala (1971)
data.summary: The December 1971 battle in Rajasthan in which Indian defenders held the Longewala post with air support.
data.content: The candidate records the battle as a bounded western-theatre event. The narrative intentionally avoids unverified vehicle-loss totals and tactical claims until a direct operational source is attached.

data.title: Lieutenant General Jagjit Singh Aurora
data.summary: The Indian Army commander who signed the 1971 Instrument of Surrender on behalf of the Indian and Bangladesh forces in the eastern theatre.
data.content: This candidate is restricted to Aurora's documented 1971 command and surrender role. It does not infer a complete biography, current status, or every unit under his command.

data.title: Vidyut-class missile boat in Operation Trident
data.summary: A candidate equipment record for the Indian Navy missile boats associated with Operation Trident in 1971.
data.content: The official source confirms Osa I class missile boats in the 1971 operations and the discovery source associates Vidyut-class boats with Operation Trident. Exact boat-level variant mapping, specifications, and service dates remain unverified and are not asserted here.
